channel.title: Mushi Mushi Blog
channel.description: Notes from building Mushi Mushi — the real numbers behind the funnel, open-source licensing, launches, and how AI-built apps get debugged in practice.

item.title: I shipped a bug tool for 5 months and got 9 signups. Here's what the data said.
item.description: Five months after launch, Mushi Mushi had 30 npm packages, an MCP server in every registry and nine signups. What the data said, and what changed.
item.dc:creator: Kenji Sakuramoto

item.title: Mushi goes AGPLv3 — the honest open source story
item.description: Why Mushi Mushi relicensed its server to AGPLv3 while keeping every SDK MIT — the open-core reasoning, what changes for self-hosters, and what stays free.
item.dc:creator: Kenji Sakuramoto

item.title: Launch Week 1 — five features, five days
item.description: Everything Mushi Mushi shipped in Launch Week 1 — one feature a day, from bug-report capture to editor-ready fixes, with demos and setup commands.
item.dc:creator: Kenji Sakuramoto

item.title: 60 seconds from "this is broken" to a draft PR — building Mushi Mushi
item.description: How Mushi Mushi turns a one-sentence user complaint into a classified, deduped, AI-judged draft PR, and why the human stays in the loop the whole way.
item.dc:creator: Kenji Sakuramoto
